reason: Numerical QA on the eight-image smoke test found score saturation near histogram endpoints made uniform 10000-bin ranking approximations too coarse. This amendment precedes all formal outer-fold fitting and evaluation.

replacement_metrics.scope: Same fixed monotone transformation for raw MSP, raw entropy, LR3 and LR3+class, primary full-population metrics and same-sample quantization QA
replacement_metrics.unchanged: All features, raw scores, group assignments, training samples, regularization grid, preprocessing, fitting objectives, retrospective targets, and exact training-derived threshold comparisons
replacement_metrics.interpretation: Ranking metrics remain grouped-bin approximations. Exact thresholds and prevalence remain full-population counts. Whole-bin RC and random secondary-key RC differ for true equal-score ties as well as quantization; report both and do not label every AURC discrepancy a quantization error.

gate: Preserve original protocol and smoke outputs; rerun synthetic and end-to-end smoke checks with revised metrics before formal nested training. Feature extraction may continue because its numerical definitions do not change.
optimization_scope: Numerical correctness only. No model, feature, group or hyperparameter is selected using smoke evaluation performance.
